Rooms.Name: Entrance to the Shadow Grove
Rooms.Description:
Before you, the grove of shadows lies. Giant grey trees are all that can be
seen through the thick shadows. A great sense of both power and menace
permeates the surrounding area. You have a strange urge to turn back and go
back the way you've come. A small path leads north into the shadows and back
south to the road.

Rooms.Name: The Shadow Grove
Rooms.Description:
You are inside the shadow grove. Giant trees seem to glare at you from all
sides. The shadowy mist obscures most of your vision. Strange sounds of moaning
and growling come from all directions. All exits lead into shadows, you are
very confused.

Rooms.Name: The Shadow Grove
Rooms.Description:
You are inside the shadow grove. Giant trees seem to glare at you from all
sides. The shadowy mist obscures most of your vision. Strange sounds moaning
and growling come from all directions. All exits lead into shadows, you are
very confused.

Exits.Description: You see a small clearing in the shadows.

Rooms.Name: The Shadow Grove
Rooms.Description:
You are inside the shadow grove. Giant trees seem the glare at you from all
sides. The shadowy mist obscures most of your vision. Strange sounds of moaning
and growling come from all directions. All exits lead into shadows, you are
very confused.

Rooms.Name: The Shadow Grove
Rooms.Description:
You are inside the shadow grove. Giant trees seem to glare at you from all
sides. The shadowy mist obscures most of your vision. Strange sounds of moaning
and growling come from all directions. All exits lead into shadows, you are
very confused.

Rooms.Name: The Shadow Grove
Rooms.Description:
You are inside the shadow grove. Giant trees seem to glare at you from all
sides. The shadowy mist obscures most of your vision. Strange sounds of moaning
and growling come from all directions. All exits lead into shadows, you are
very confused.

Rooms.Name: The Shadow Grove
Rooms.Description:
You are inside the shadow grove. Giant trees seem to glare at you from all
sides. The shadowy mist obscures most of your vision. Strange sounds of moaning
and growling come from all directions. All exits lead into shadows, you are
very confused.

Rooms.Name: The Shadow Grove
Rooms.Description:
You are inside the shadow grove. Giant trees seem to glare at you from all
sides. The shadowy mist obscures most of your vision. Strange sounds of moaning
and growling come from all directions. All exits lead into shadows, you are
very confused.

Rooms.Name: The Shadow Grove
Rooms.Description:
You are inside the shadow grove. Giant trees seem to glare at you from all
sides. The shadowy mist obscures most of your vision. Strange sounds of moaning
and growling come from all directions. All exits lead into shadows, you are
very confused.

Rooms.Name: The Shadow Grove
Rooms.Description:
You are inside the shadow grove. Giant trees seem to glare at you from all
sides. The shadowy mist obscures most of your vision. Strange sounds of moaning
and growling come from all directions. All directions lead into shadows, you
are very confused.

Rooms.Name: A small clearing
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small clearing before a tower. There is charred grass
underfoot, and the signs of fire here and there. It is almost as if the plant
life shuns this spot. The shadowy mist hovers all around, obscuring your view
into the grove. A small path leads north to some shadowy structure.

Exits.Description: You can barely make out some sort of building to the north.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to the High Tower
Rooms.Description:
You have reached the entrance to the high tower of sorcerery. The tower
looms above you at an incredible height. It seems to disappear into the storm
clouds above. A diamond gate is to the north, guarded by a huge golem. The
trail back south has almost disappeared behind you.

Exits.Description: The diamond gate looks incredibly strong.

Rooms.Name: Inside the High Tower of Sorcerery
Rooms.Description:
You are inside the high tower of sorcery. The sight is truly amazing. From
here, it is obvious that somehow, the tower is much larger on the inside than
it is on the outside. Young mages walk about, completely oblivious to your
presence. Exits lead north to the common room, west to the dinning room, east
to a plain hallway and back south through the gate.

Exits.Description: The common room looks quite busy and noisy.

Rooms.Name: Common Room
Rooms.Description:
You are in the common room. There are many apprentice warlocks here talking
and resting, playing games, comparing notes. Obviously they are taking a break
from their rigorous studies. There are benches, tables and a small water
fountain here, otherwise the room is quite unremarkable. Exits lead off in all
directions.

Exits.Description: The mages bar can be seen to the east.

Rooms.Name: The Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway, it seems rather unremarkable. The hallway
continues east and back west.

Rooms.Name: Dining Room
Rooms.Description:
You are in the dining area of the student mages. From the number of tables
and chairs here, you can see that this room could easily seat several hundred
people. It is oddly deserted here, obviously not meal time. Exits lead west to
the kitchen, and back east.

Rooms.Name: Dark Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a dark hallway. It is apparent that this area is seldom used by
the regular occupants of the tower. Dust covers the floors here. The faint
outline of a trapdoor can be seen in the dust.

Rooms.Name: Mages Tavern
Rooms.Description:
You are in mages tavern. The air is smoky and filled with the smells of
foreign food and drink. The other patrons pay you little heed, as they
obviously have more interesting things to contemplate. Midori the bartender is
here waiting to take your order. The only exit leads back west.

Rooms.Name: The Magic Shop
Rooms.Description:
You are in the High Tower's store of magic. Slick Willy stands behind the
counter, selling all sorts of herbs, parchment and other reagents used in
magical studies. The only exit leads back east to the common room.

Rooms.Name: the kitchen
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small kitchen. All the usual kitchen type utensils and
equipment is here, including some not so usual ones. Among the latter, a huge
black oven against one wall, it must be at least 12 feet high. Opposite the
oven is an equally enormous meat locker, large enough to comfortably store
several hapless adventurers no doubt. In the middle of the room, hanging in
mid-air is a spice rack.

Rooms.Name: Below the trapdoor
Rooms.Description:
You are below the trapdoor. It is very dark and dusty here, very little
light filters through from above. A faint sound of dripping water can be heard
in the distance below. A rope ladder leads down.

Rooms.Name: A damp intersection
Rooms.Description:
You are in a damp intersection of what seems to be the basement of the
tower. The sound of running water can be heard coming from the south, other
than that, an almost tangible stillness fills the air. Passages lead off in all
directions, and a ladder leads up.

Exits.Description: A faint light can be seen in the distance up the east passage.

Rooms.Name: A dark passage
Rooms.Description:
You are at the end of a dark passage which ends in a stout wooden door.
Other then through the door, the only apparent exit is back the way you came.

Rooms.Name: A dark passage
Rooms.Description:
You are at the end of a dark passage. A half opened door is to the east,
shedding soft light around the edges. Faint snoring sounds can be heard behind
the door. Exits lead east through the door, or back west.

Rooms.Name: The stagnant pool
Rooms.Description:
You are at the edge of a stagnant pool of water. The smell here is quite
nauseating. This is apparently where the denizens of the tower dispose of their
garbage. Faint gurgling can be heard from beneath the surface of the pool.
Exits lead back north, or perhaps for the very adventurous, down into the pool.

Exits.Description: No light penetrates the gloom of the stagnant pool.

Rooms.Name: A dark passage
Rooms.Description:
You are in a dark passage, which comes to an abrupt stop at what appears to
be a cave-in to the west. It is certainly unpassable, and perhaps quite
dangerous just being this close. The only exit leads back east.

Rooms.Name: A dark cell
Rooms.Description:
You are in a dark cell. Straw and dirt cover the floors here, it is very
dark. Someone, or something seems to be chained to the far wall. The only exit
is back south.

Rooms.Name: The Jailer's office
Rooms.Description:
You are in the Jailor's office. It is rather messy here. Judging by the
sleeping form of the Jailor on duty, you can surmise that very few, if any
prisoners survive long enough to spend much time in these dank dungeons. The
only exit leads back west.

Rooms.Name: Below the stagnant pool
Rooms.Description:
As you dive beneath the putrid waters, you feel a strong tug and a whirlpool
drags you under. You are sucked into blackness. You feel your lungs burst from
lack of oxygen. Just as you feel your life fading, you notice a change in
direction ... and are sucked under by a rip tide.

Rooms.Name: The hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

Rooms.Name: A bend in the hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are at a bend in the hallway. The walls emit a faint magical glow which
provides enough light to see by.

Rooms.Name: A store room
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small store room. Assorted junk is piled on shelves or leaning
against walls. The only apparent exit it back south.

Rooms.Name: A broom closet
Rooms.Description:
You are in a dark broom closet. Many straw brooms and other cleaning
instruments have been left here, apparently unused (perhaps the maid quit?).
The only exit leads back north to the hallway.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The walls shed a warm light

Rooms.Name: Guardian's chamber
Rooms.Description:
You are in the chamber of the tower guardians. It is rather sparsely
furnished, but then again the odd occupants don't look to need furniture. Here
and there a disembodied pair of hands or eyes flits about.

Rooms.Name: A guest bedroom
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small guest bedroom. A small cot is in one corner, and a dusty
mirror on one wall, other than that the room looks quite bare, and unused. The
only apparent exit leads back west to the hallway.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Why, someone seems to be looking back at you from the other side!

Rooms.Name: A guest bedroom
Rooms.Description:
You are in a comfortable looking bedroom. A small globe of magical energy
floats overhead, providing light. A small cot is in one corner looking ever so
comfortable, so comfortable in fact ... someone is sleeping in it. The only
apparent exit leads back west to the hallway.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading from the south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. Stairs lead up to the next
level and the hallway leads back south.

Rooms.Name: The burnt room
Rooms.Description:
You are in what looks to have once been a guest bed room. The walls are
blackened and burnt by what you could only imagine to be magical fire. There is
no sign of the previous occupant, undoubtedly he left in a hurry. The only exit
leads back west to the hallway.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading west from here. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. Some faint moonlight can be
seen in the culdesac to the east. The hallway continues west and stairs lead
down to the level below.

Exits.Description: Faint moonlight can be seen to the east.

Rooms.Name: A culdesac
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small culdesac. A window to the east is letting in moonlight
and a pleasant breeze. Through it, the surrounding country side can be seen.
The only apparent exit leads back west to the hallway.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Stretching out as far as the eye can see is a canopy of dark tree tops
which can only be a dense forest.  A faint light in the distance to the 
northeast marks what is probably the city of midgaard.

Rooms.Name: The Apprentice's Barracks
Rooms.Description:
You are in the barracks of the apprentice magic users. Here and there, a
young apprentice sits engrossed in magical study, or practicing a feeble
cantrip. Cots line the walls, and the room continues west.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. There is a door to the
north, and the hallway continues west or back east.

Rooms.Name: The Apprentice's barracks
Rooms.Description:
You are in the barracks of the apprentice magic users. Here and there, a
young apprentice sits engrossed in magical study, or practicing a feeble
cantrip. Cots line the walls, and the room continues east.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. Flashes of light can be
seen under the doorway to the north.

Exits.Description: A flash of blue light momentarily lights up the doors outline.

Rooms.Name: The apprentice's workshop
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small workshop. Writing implements and parchment are strewn
about on a few worktables. In the far corner several young mages have a small
kitten cornered and seem to be testing spells upon it. The only apparent exit
leads back south to the hallway.

Rooms.Name: A bend in the hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are at a bend in the hallway. The walls emit a faint magical glow which
provides enough light to see by. The hallway continues south and back east.

Rooms.Name: The hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. There is a closed metal
door to the west.

Rooms.Name: A classroom
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large classroom filled with bored looking students of the art.
The instructor stops in his lecture on the fine uses of magic missile at your
entry and lunges to attack you. The only apparent exit is back east to the
hallway.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

Rooms.Name: An empty classroom
Rooms.Description:
You are in an empty classroom. Some strange sigils are written on a
blackboard which is floating in the air here. Other than a few desks, it is
bare of furnishings. The only apparent exit leads back east to the hallway.

Rooms.Name: A bend in the hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are at a bend in the hallway. The walls emit a faint magical glow which
provides enough light to see by. The hallway continues east and north.

Rooms.Name: An empty classroom
Rooms.Description:
You are in an apparently empty classroom. A strange feeling of being watched
comes over you, and you hear the faint rustle of robes. The only apparent exit
is back east to the hallway.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. A sturdy iron door can be
seen to the south.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. There is a large oaken door
to the south.

Rooms.Name: The Amphitheater
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small amphitheater. Rows of comfortable looking chairs circle a
large podium. The echoes of your footsteps seem very loud here. The only
apparent exit leads north to the hallway.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow providing enough light to see by. A small door can be seen to the
south.

Rooms.Name: The training room
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large training room. It is filled with battle scared mannequins,
and many other devices used in the practice of fighting.

Rooms.Name: A bend in the hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are at a bend in the hallway. The walls emit a faint magical glow which
provides enough light to see by. The hallway continues north and west.

Rooms.Name: A dueling room
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large room used for duels arcane. The walls, ceiling and floor
all bare the scars of many fiery spells, but still look quite strong and hold
fast. The only exit leads north to the hallway.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. A doorway can be seen to
the east.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. A wooden door can been seen
to the east.

Rooms.Name: The spellmaster's lounge
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large comfortable looking lounge. Off duty spell teachers are
here relaxing in their idle time. A large coffee machine is against the far
wall. The only apparent exit leads back west to the hallway.

Rooms.Name: A bedroom
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large, plush bedroom. The owner is obviously someone of high
standing in the magical community here. An ice mirror is on one wall, and a
scrying globe sit on a stand in the middle of the room. An enormous bed can be
seen floating about a meter above the floor. The only exit leads back west to
the hallway.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow providing enough light to see by. A glass door can be seen to the
east.

Rooms.Name: The study
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small, well kept study. Ancient tomes are on shelves on the
walls, A huge table sits in the middle of the room, with maps weighted down
upon it. The only light source here comes from an interestingly non- magical
oil lamp. The only apparent exit leads back west to the hallway.

Rooms.Name: Below the stairs
Rooms.Description:
You are at the end of a long hallway. The walls emit a faint magical glow
which provides enough light to see by. A lesser guardian is here keeping silent
watch on the entrance to the levels above. Stairs lead up and the hallway
continues back south.

Rooms.Name: Atop the stairway
Rooms.Description:
You are atop a stairway. The halls here look quite a bit less used than
those below. Obviously access to these magic filled corridors is limited to
those of the upper echelon of mages. The walls here emit a faint blue magical
aura which provides some light. The hallway leads west from here and the stairs
go down.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway stretching east and west. The walls here emit a
faint magical energy providing enough light to see by. There is a thick looking
wooden door to the north.

Rooms.Name: A small office
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small office. It looks like a calligrapher's study, there are
quills, ink pots and parchments all about on desks and worktables. A section to
the west seems to be curtained off, but the flicker of a candle can be seen
through the curtain.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

Rooms.Name: The master scribe's workshop
Rooms.Description:
You are in the workshop of the tower's master scribe. Many half finished
scrolls lay on the writing table in the center of the room. A giant candle
flickering with soft blue flames provides the only light here. The only
apparent exit is the way you came in.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. A half closed door can be
seen to the north.

Exits.Description: A dark room can be seen through the half opened door

Rooms.Name: A store room
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small dark store room. A few common items are stacked upon the
shelves here, but very little looks interesting.

Rooms.Name: A bend in the hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are at a bend in the long hallway. The walls emit a faint magical glow
which provides enough light to see by. The hallway continues south and east
from here.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. An iron bound door can be
seen to the west.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. The sharp sound of metal on
metal can be heard to the west.

Rooms.Name: A store room
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large store room. Bins of ores, minerals and other rare
materials are here along with many neatly stacked piles of precious metals. A
large cabinet with sigils of warding is bolted to one wall. The ring of metal
on metal can be heard to the south.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

Rooms.Name: A very hot room
Rooms.Description:
You are in a very hot room. Against one wall is a large forge, magical fires
crackle within and heavy blue smoke pours into a vent in the ceiling. A
rune-encrusted mithril anvil is in the center of the room, looking well used.
Other tools of metallurgy hang on a rack which floats about three meters in the
air of its own force.

Rooms.Name: The master Enchanter's chamber
Rooms.Description:
You have entered the master enchanter's chamber. Upon all the walls here are
racks of finely crafted weapons. A huge chest with a glowing lock is set to one
side. Several unfinished looking blades rest atop a small work table.

Rooms.Name: A bend in the hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are at a bend in a long hallway. The walls emit a faint magical glow
which provides enough light to see by. The hallway continues north and east.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. A steel door can be seen to
the south.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

Rooms.Name: A laboratory
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small laboratory. Many strange instruments, vials, bottles and
some scrawled notes are piled about a workbench. This room is very untidy,
looking almost abandoned, or used by a madman. The only apparent exits are east
and north.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. You can see a steel door to
the south.

Rooms.Name: The Mad Alchemist's workroom
Rooms.Description:
You are in the workroom of The Mad Alchemist. Bubbling braziers, long glass
tubes and scores of oddly shaped vials and bottles are everywhere. It is
incredibly messy here, crushed glass and other trash litter the floor. The only
apparent exit is the one you entered by.

Rooms.Name: A bend in the hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are at a bend in a long hallway. The walls emit a faint magical glow
which provides enough light to see by. The hallway continues north and west.

Rooms.Name: The pentagram chamber
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large room with a five pointed star etched into the floor. A
crackling energy field can be seen to the south, it looks quite dangerous.

Exits.Description: The energy field crackles and glows, nothing seems to be beyond.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. A bronze door can be seen
to the east.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Energy Field
Rooms.Description:
You feel a stomach twisting sensation as you enter the energy field. Nice
going! You might as well wait here until the wizard who built this trap comes
back to imprison your soul as well as your body.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. A bronze door can be seen
to the east.

Rooms.Name: An empty room
Rooms.Description:
You are in an empty room. It is both quiet and comfortable here, it looks
like a safe place to rest.

Rooms.Name: The charm master's chamber
Rooms.Description:
You are in the chambers of the tower's master of charm. Some straw and dirt
litters the floor here, it looks to have been recently used by wild animals.
Strange sounds can be heard through the bars to the north.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

Rooms.Name: The animal pens
Rooms.Description:
You are in the animal pens. Many caged animals are here looking unhappy.
Obviously they are destined to be enslaved, or used in some cruel magical
experimentation.

Rooms.Name: The end of the hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are at the end of a long north-south hallway. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. Stairs here lead up to the
next level, and the hallway continues south.

Rooms.Name: Atop the stairway
Rooms.Description:
You are atop the stairway to the upper levels of the high tower. The walls
emit a faint magical glow which provides enough light to see by. A hallway
leads west from here, and the stairs lead down.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. A silver door can be seen
to the north.

Rooms.Name: A store room
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large store room. Raw materials are neatly bundled and piled
here and here. Many freshly cut staves rods and wands of different sizes are
here. You can see a silver door to the west.

Rooms.Name: The master spellbinder's chamber
Rooms.Description:
You are in the chambers of the master spell binder. Unlike other work shops
of similar nature, this one is without furnishings or tools. The spell binder
obviously needs none for the working of his art. A silver door can be seen to
the west.

Rooms.Name: The spellbinder's cache
Rooms.Description:
You have discovered the cache of the master spell binder. There are three
very large silver chased cabinets here, other than that, the room is bare. A
silver door can be seen to the south.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. A silver door can be seen
to the north.

Rooms.Name: A bend in the hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are at a bend in the long hallway. The walls emit a faint magical glow
which provides enough light to see by. The hallway continues east and south.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. A rusty old door can be
seen to the west.

Rooms.Name: The golem master's workshop
Rooms.Description:
You are in the golem master's workshop. A few unfinished looking humanoid
forms of different make are here, some moving, some not. The animated forms
lunge to attack you.

Rooms.Name: A store room
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small store room. Large chunks of clay, stone, wood and many
other raw materials are here.

Rooms.Name: The golem chamber
Rooms.Description:
You are in the golem chamber. Golems made of every imaginable material are
here, ranging in size from a hand-span to nearly the ceiling. They all seem to
be sleeping.

Rooms.Name: It is very dark here...
Rooms.Description: It is very dark here...

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

Rooms.Name: A bend in the hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are at a bend in the long hallway. The walls emit a faint magical glow
which provides enough light to see by. The hallway continues north and east
from here.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. An emerald door can be seen
to the south.

Rooms.Name: The master of illusion's chamber
Rooms.Description:
You are in the chamber of the master of illusions. The walls here are every
changing in color and texture, as if they were reforming before your very eyes.
Many splendorous treasures lie all around in heaps and piles, or at least they
seem to be treasures...

Rooms.Name: A bedroom
Rooms.Description:
You are in the bedroom of the master of illusions. Strange looking items and
artifacts float here and there in the air. The ripples of strong magic can be
felt everywhere. The room seems much larger than it looks...

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading east and west. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. A glass door can be seen to
the south.

Rooms.Name: The meditation chamber
Rooms.Description:
You are in a meditation chamber. It is very silent here, in fact you can not
even hear your own footsteps. You feel very peaceful.

Rooms.Name: A bend in the hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are at a bend in the long hallway. The walls emit a faint magical glow
which provides enough light to see by. The hallway continues north and west
from here.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by. A blackened door can be
seen to the east.

Rooms.Name: A dark room
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large dark room. The air here seems quite stale, and a sense of
extreme dread comes over you. The stench of rotten flesh seems to be wafting in
from the open doorway to the north.

Rooms.Name: A dark room
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large dark room. The stench here makes you gag and wretch.
There are body parts and half rotted corpses strewn about with complete
abandon. Several operating tables with still forms that resemble nothing you've
ever seen alive are here. Tortured screams can be heard from the north.

Exits.Description: Upon gazing northwards, you are filled with deep dread.

Rooms.Name: The Necromancer's Lair
Rooms.Description:
You are in the lair of the evil Necromancer. Undead minions of all types,
human and otherwise stand here waiting to do their master's bidding. Some
glowing arcane sigils have been etched into walls and floor, no doubt to
protect the evil master from his own ungodly creations.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

Rooms.Name: A hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway leading north and south. The walls emit a faint
magical glow which provides enough light to see by.

Rooms.Name: The end of the hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are at the end of a long hallway. The walls here glow with a faint
magical energy which provides plenty of light. Stairs lead up to the next level
here and the hallway continues south.

Rooms.Name: A corridor
Rooms.Description:
You are at the east end of a long corridor. Obsidian walls engraved with
ancient runes of power stretch out before you. Magical energies seem to crackle
with power all around and whisper in tongues long forgotten, almost as if the
corridor it self were alive.

Rooms.Name: A corridor
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long corridor. Obsidian walls engraved with ancient runes of
power stretch out before you. Magical energies seem to crackle with power all
around and whisper in tongues long forgotten, almost as if the corridor itself
were alive.

Rooms.Name: A bend in the corridor
Rooms.Description:
You are at a bend in the long corridor. Obsidian walls engraved with ancient
runes of power stretch out before you. Magical energies seem to crackle with
power all around and whisper in tongues long forgotten, almost as if the
corridor itself were alive.

Rooms.Name: A corridor
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long corridor leading north and south. Obsidian walls engraved
with ancient runes of power stretch out before you. Magical energies seem to
crackle with power all around and whisper in tongues long forgotten, almost as
if the corridor itself were alive.

Rooms.Name: An intersection
Rooms.Description:
You are at an intersection in the corridor. The obsidian walled halls lead
off in every direction from here, pulsing with the power of their ancient
runes.

Rooms.Name: A corridor
Rooms.Description:
You are at the end of a long corridor. Obsidian walls engraved with ancient
runes of power stretch out before you. A darkened door is to the east. Tendrils
of mist cling to the floor here, they seem to be seeping from under the door.

Rooms.Name: The scrying chamber
Rooms.Description:
You are in the scrying chamber of the high tower of sorcerery. It is here
that arcane rituals are performed to enable those of the art to look in upon
denizens throughout the world and spy out their darkest secrets. A huge black
cauldron is in the center of the room, bubbling and gurgling, it pours forth a
constant stream of smoky fog into the air about you. Here and there on stands
of different sizes are crystal balls and oddly shaped mirrors.

Rooms.Name: A corridor
Rooms.Description:
You have reached an end in the long corridor. Obsidian walls engraved with
ancient runes of power stretch out before you. The sound of snoring can barely
be heard through the door to the west.

Rooms.Name: The entrance to the library
Rooms.Description:
You are in the entrance to the great library of magic. A giant desk is here,
covered with books parchments and scrolls. Long shelves loaded with row upon
row of books stretch out in every direction as far as the eye can see.

Exits.Description: All you can see are books.
All you can see are books.

Rooms.Name: In the library
Rooms.Description:
You are in the great library of magic. A strong musty smell permeates the
entire area. Upon shelves which float just out of reach are hundreds of books,
tomes and scrolls of every possible shape size and color. The elusive books
seem to wink in and out of existence before your untrained eyes. It is very
quiet here.

Rooms.Name: In the library
Rooms.Description:
You are in the great library of magic. A strong musty smell permeates the
entire area. Upon shelves which float just out of reach are hundreds of books,
tomes and scrolls of every possible shape size and color. The elusive books
seem to wink in and out of existence before your untrained eyes. It is very
quiet here.

Rooms.Name: In the library
Rooms.Description:
You are in the great library of magic. A strong musty smell permeates the
entire area. Upon shelves which float just out of reach are hundreds of books,
tomes and scrolls of every possible shape size and color. The elusive books
seem to wink in and out of existence before your untrained eyes. It is very
quiet here.

Rooms.Name: In the library
Rooms.Description:
You are in the great library of magic. A strong musty smell permeates the
entire area. Upon shelves which float just out of reach are hundreds of books,
tomes and scrolls of every possible shape size and color. The elusive books
seem to wink in and out of existence before your untrained eyes. It is very
quiet here.

Rooms.Name: In the library
Rooms.Description:
You are in the great library of magic. A strong musty smell permeates the
entire area. Upon shelves which float just out of reach are hundreds of books,
tomes and scrolls of every possible shape size and color. The elusive books
seem to wink in and out of existence before your untrained eyes. It is very
quiet here.

Rooms.Name: In the library
Rooms.Description:
You are in the great library of magic. A strong musty smell permeates the
entire area. Upon shelves which float just out of reach are hundreds of books,
tomes and scrolls of every possible shape size and color. The elusive books
seem to wink in and out of existence before your untrained eyes. It is very
quiet here.

Rooms.Name: Between the shelves
Rooms.Description:
You are in the great library of magic. The shelves seem uncomfortably close
here, you can barely maneuver between them. The musty smell is still strong,
and the elusive books still hover just out of reach. A faint flicker of light
can barely be made out to the north.

Rooms.Name: The reading room
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small room completely devoid of furnishings. The only thing
here is an enormous tome, lying face open on the floor. The great book looks
both heavy and ancient. Its jewel encrusted bindings are well worn as the bark
of a tree. Spidery writings seem to crawl across the pages, totally
incomprehensible to your mortal eye. Something seems to be wedged between the
pages.

Rooms.Name: A corridor
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long corridor leading north and south. Obsidian walls engraved
with ancient runes of power stretch out before you. Magical energies seem to
crackle with power all around and whisper in tongues long forgotten, almost as
if the corridor itself were alive.

Rooms.Name: The end of the corridor
Rooms.Description:
You are at the end of a long corridor. The obsidian walls come to an abrupt
halt at the edge of a golden archway here. The hum of power is so strong it
nearly numbs your body. The archway lies before you, glowing and pulsing with
energy.

Rooms.Name: The arched entrance
Rooms.Description:
You feel a slight tingle as you pass through the archway, as if the living
magical energies here had infused your body, found it wanting and left. The
intense glow from the arch above you is almost blinding. Through the light you
can barely make out a stairway leading up.

Rooms.Name: The landing
Rooms.Description:
You are on a small landing in the middle of a long stairway leading up. Your
senses seem dulled here, no sound or smell can be detected at all, and the only
thing you can see in any direction is endless stairway.

Rooms.Name: An intersection
Rooms.Description:
You are at an intersection of several hallways. You feel as if strange
mystical forces are pushing and pulling at each other from all around you. The
sensation of being trapped, in the middle is almost tangible in the air here. A
grey tiled hallway leads south, black tiled east, white tiled west, and a
multi-colored hallway swirling with patterns that remain just barely
unrecognizable is to the north.

Rooms.Name: A grey tiled hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a grey tiled hallway leading north and south. Dim balls of energy
float here and there shedding a warm light, and showing the way. A feeling of
peace and balance comes over you.

Rooms.Name: A grey tiled hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a grey tiled hallway leading north and south. Dim balls of energy
float here and there shedding a warm light, and showing the way. A feeling of
peace and balance comes over you. Large grey metal double doors can be seen to
the south.

Rooms.Name: The antechamber
Rooms.Description:
You are in the antechamber of the master magician of the grey light. A
feeling of strong magic floats in the air about you, almost as if you could
taste the power held within these walls. Once your eyes adjust to the
semi-light, you can make out a larger room to the south.

Rooms.Name: The main chamber
Rooms.Description:
A feeling of tranquillity comes over you as you enter the main chamber of
neutrality. Some artifacts are hung on the walls here, or set on stands. The
room in general looks both comfortable and official. Probably where the master
of neutrality holds audience.

Rooms.Name: The study
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large study. Shelves filled with many books or arcane knowledge
are on every wall. A large oaken desk is in the center, with many parchments
and scrolls on it. The most notable thing in the room is a small set of scales,
which floats about eye level. In perfect balance, the scales are no doubt a
sign of the master's neutrality.

Rooms.Name: A closet
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small closet. It is filled with many cloaks, and some other
apparel.

Rooms.Name: A bedroom
Rooms.Description:
You are in the bedroom of the master magician of neutrality. Curtained
windows can be seen on the south wall. A large comfortable looking bed takes up
most of the room.

Rooms.Name: A dark hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long dark hallway leading east and west. Not much can be seen
in the unnatural darkness here, but you get a deep sense of dread the further
you go.

Rooms.Name: A dark hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long dark hallway leading east and west. Not much can be seen
in the unnatural darkness here, but you get a deep sense of dread the further
you go.

Rooms.Name: The end of the hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are at the end of a long dark hallway. The darkness here is almost
tangible in its thickness. A deep sense of fear and loathing comes over you. A
pair of obsidian doors can be seen to the east.

Rooms.Name: The chamber of darkness
Rooms.Description:
You are in a vast chamber. The walls fade into darkness, leaving you with a
very vague idea of the actual size of the room. Swirling here and there in the
dark, are patches of pure black which seem to suck in your light and leave it
that much darker here.

Rooms.Name: It is very dark here...
Rooms.Description: It is very dark here...

Rooms.Name: Torture chamber
Rooms.Description:
You are in an ill lit chamber. Instruments of torture hang from a rack on
the wall, they seem to quiver with anticipation of a victim as if they had a
mind of their own. An operating table is here, though it is bare. An extreme
feeling of evil permeates the entire area.

Rooms.Name: The inner chamber
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small dark chamber. Upon the walls are glowing sigils of dark
power, scrawled and traced in an evil language no longer known to most of this
plane of existence. There is an obsidian altar here which seems to glow, but
does not shed any light, in fact it seems to be taking light in.

Rooms.Name: A bright hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long well lit hallway leading east and west. The walls here are
a milky white color, and glow with a warm luminescence, as does the floor. A
feeling of goodness permeates the area, and you feel unworthy to tread upon
these sacred floors.

Rooms.Name: A bright hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long well lit hallway leading east and west. The walls here are
a milky white color, and glow with a warm luminescence, as does the floor. A
feeling of goodness permeates the area, and you feel unworthy to tread upon
these sacred floors. A huge set of double doors in finely worked ivory can be
seen to the west.

Rooms.Name: An antechamber
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small antechamber. It is well lit here, though the source of
light cannot be seen. It is almost as if the room itself exudes a warm glow of
goodness. A larger chamber can be seen to the west, but you do not feel worthy
to pass into it.

Rooms.Name: The chamber of the white light
Rooms.Description:
You are in a vast chamber, its walls floor and ceiling are of an unknown
metallic material, the brightest white, almost blindingly stark. A flickering
flame is in the center of the room, seeming to feed off of darkness and
cleansing the room of any evil. You feel a slight tug at your being as the
flame flickers towards you.

Rooms.Name: The meditation chamber
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small meditation chamber. White silk cushions are everywhere,
looking very comfortable. You get an easy peaceful feeling of relaxation here,
almost making you want to lie down and fall asleep.

Rooms.Name: A study
Rooms.Description:
You are in a spacious study. It is extremely tidy here, to an almost
antiseptic nature. One would wonder how anyone could study without a mess all
around them, the master of this chamber obviously can.

Rooms.Name: A closet
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small closet. Cloaks and vests hang from hooks in the wall, and
a few old boots are all that can be seen here. Rather featureless.

Rooms.Name: A wide hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large hallway, wide enough to accommodate several people
standing abreast. The floor here is a swirl of multicolored patterns, in
constant motion. A huge grey metal door blocks the way north, it looks quite
sturdy.

Rooms.Name: A wide hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large hallway, wide enough to accommodate several people
standing abreast. The floor here is a swirl of multicolored patterns, in
constant motion. A huge black obsidian door blocks the way north, it looks
quite sturdy.

Rooms.Name: A wide hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large hallway, wide enough to accommodate several people
standing abreast. The floor here is a swirl of multicolored patterns, in
constant motion. A huge white ivory door blocks the way north, it looks quite
sturdy.

Rooms.Name: The entrance way
Rooms.Description:
You are at the entrance to the audience chamber of the grand master of
magic. Beautiful tapestries displaying the ancient masters of lore are on the
walls, and the floor is covered with a plush multicolored carpet, which seems
to rustle and move at the touch of your boots.

Rooms.Name: The audience chamber
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large chamber. Small bolts of energy leap from wall to wall,
crackling with power. The floor is a swirl of indeterminable colors and
patterns ever changing. Bright bursts of color seem to explode into the air and
fade again at random times. All this splendor plays about and draws attention
to a large throne in the center of the room, it seems to be cut from a single
enormous emerald.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The giant emerald is flawless, and must be incredibly valuable.

Rooms.Name: A dressing room
Rooms.Description:
You are in a plush dressing room. Fine garments of many styles and some
outlandish colors hang from a rack suspended in mid air at eye level. The only
other interesting feature in the room is a large silver mirror on a finely
crafted gold stand.

Rooms.Name: The library
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small cozy looking library. A few well made books sit atop
shelves which span every wall. A large oaken writing table is in the center of
the room with odd papers and parchments on it. The illumination here, to your
surprise is a quite un-magical oil lamp.

Rooms.Name: The altar
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small chapel designed around a beautifully crafted golden
altar. Many icons to lesser deities line the room, but it is obvious by one
glance at the symbols on the altar, that this room was designed for the worship
of Mantis, the god of magic.

Rooms.Name: The treasury
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small chamber, the stale air here is testament to the fact that
it has gone undisturbed for many years.

Rooms.Name: A passage
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small dark passage, which would be unremarkable if not for the
fact that it ends in a blinding blue light to the west. On hooks set into the
wall here there hang several travel worthy cloaks, and a small leather
backpack. It looks as if someone has prepared this room to be used in the event
of a speedy evacuation.

Rooms.Name: In the light
Rooms.Description:
You seem to be floating in a magical energy field, though you cannot see the
source of the energy, you can feel its power pushing at you from all sides,
completely negating the effects of gravity. An imperfection in the uniform blue
can be seen overhead, it might be an exit.

Mobs.Name: guardian shadow
Mobs.LongDescription: A shadow guardian screams a challenge and attacks.
Mobs.Description: It seems to be made of nothing more than darkness ...

Mobs.Name: adventurer lost
Mobs.LongDescription: An emaciated adventurer is here looking lost and hopeless.
Mobs.Description:
He looks haggard and sickly; no doubt he's been lost here for quite 
some time.

Mobs.Name: dewey human
Mobs.LongDescription: Dewey the Human SpellStudent
Mobs.Description: Dewey says 'pardon me, have you seen a god on lately?'
Mobs.ActionScript: %%15 say pardon me, have you seen a god on lately?

Mobs.Name: golem huge
Mobs.LongDescription: A huge diamond golem is standing guard here.
Mobs.Description: It looks quite strong.

Mobs.Name: mage young
Mobs.LongDescription: A young mage wanders about, oblivious to all.
Mobs.Description:
He seems to be contemplating life, love and the mysteries of the universe.
Then again, he may just have a headache.

Mobs.Name: midori bartender
Mobs.LongDescription: Midori is here levitating drinks to his customers.
Mobs.Description: He looks rather harmless, but then again so does a sleeping dragon.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%20 say Have you heard about the strange hole in the forest.;
%20 say I have heard that the hole is the entrance way to Hell it self.

Mobs.Name: willy slick
Mobs.LongDescription: Slick Willy the wizard is here counting his earnings.
Mobs.Description: Slick Willy smiles and shows you his pasty white thighs.

Mobs.Name: emerald cook
Mobs.LongDescription: Emerald the cook is here stirring a large pot of something.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%20 say You have to wait for the dinner, as all others have to!

Mobs.Name: assistant cook
Mobs.LongDescription: The cook's assistant is here assisting the cook.

Mobs.Name: prisoner
Mobs.LongDescription: A prisoner is chained to the wall here.
Mobs.Description:
Though his clothes are all in rags, you can see that at one time they must
have been fine garments. A metal muzzle has been fitted over the poor
wretch's mouth, whether to keep him from screaming, or to silence his spell
casting you cannot tell.

He looks quite mad, no doubt he's been mistreated horribly.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%15 say Please help me!, my father will reward you.

Mobs.Name: jailor
Mobs.LongDescription: The Jailor is here enjoying a comfortable nap.
Mobs.Description: He looks rather dirty.

Mobs.Name: broom
Mobs.LongDescription: A straw broom is here leaning against the wall.
Mobs.Description: The broom screams 'Take that you lout!'

Mobs.Name: hands pair
Mobs.LongDescription: A pair of disembodied hands floats in the air here.
Mobs.Description: The hands twitch with anticipation of strangling someone.

Mobs.Name: eyes pair
Mobs.LongDescription: A pair of disembodied eyes floats here glaring at you.
Mobs.Description: The eyes smolder with hatred.

Mobs.Name: mage visiting
Mobs.LongDescription: A visiting mage is here snoring away in peaceful slumber.
Mobs.Description: He looks quite sleepy.

Mobs.Name: apprentice mage young magic user
Mobs.LongDescription: A young apprentice magic user is here doing magical studies.
Mobs.Description: She looks quite intent on her studies.

Mobs.Name: apprentice mage young
Mobs.LongDescription: A young apprentice is here mumbling words of magic to himself.
Mobs.Description: He looks to be oblivious to all but the spell he is memorizing.

Mobs.Name: apprentice mage young
Mobs.LongDescription: A young apprentice is sleeping here.
Mobs.Description: He seems to be dreaming.

Mobs.Name: apprentice mage young
Mobs.LongDescription: A young apprentice is here teasing a cornered kitten.
Mobs.Description: He looks like a mischievous youth.

Mobs.Name: kitten small
Mobs.LongDescription: A small kitten is here meowing in terror.
Mobs.Description:
The little ball of fur looks very unhappy.  Singed fur and a few minor burn
mark its mottled coat.

Mobs.Name: student
Mobs.LongDescription: A student of spells is here looking quite bored.
Mobs.Description: The student yawns.

Mobs.Name: instructor
Mobs.LongDescription: The instructor screams at your interruption and attacks you.
Mobs.Description: He looks quite angry at your interruption.

Mobs.Name: student
Mobs.LongDescription: A student of spells is here trying to master invisibility.
Mobs.Description: He blinks in and out of existence, trying to master the spell.

Mobs.Name: teacher
Mobs.LongDescription: A spell teacher screams at your interruption and attacks.

Mobs.Name: student
Mobs.LongDescription: A student of spells has fallen asleep at her desk here.
Mobs.Description: She looks to have collapsed from sheer boredom.

Mobs.Name: wizard old
Mobs.LongDescription: An old wizard is here making a speech
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%20 say The key to be a succesful mage is wisdom.;
%20 say Times change quickly and you need to be prepared.

Mobs.Name: mage young
Mobs.LongDescription: A young mage is here learning hand to hand combat.

Mobs.Name: mistress battle
Mobs.LongDescription: The battle mistress is here teaching the fine uses of a dagger.
Mobs.Description:
She looks quite rugged. In fact, she more resembles a warrior than a magic
user.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%20 say Try to fight like MEN, ok again.

Mobs.Name: teacher
Mobs.LongDescription: A spell teacher is here relaxing.

Mobs.Name: wizard aged
Mobs.LongDescription: An aged wizard is sleeping here.

Mobs.Name: scribe
Mobs.LongDescription: A scribe is here working on some manuscripts.

Mobs.Name: scribe
Mobs.LongDescription: A scribe is here working diligently on some translations.
Mobs.Description:
She's quite cute.  Too bad her only interest seems to be the words of
lore she is translating.

Mobs.Name: master scribe
Mobs.LongDescription: The master scribe is here looking a little upset.
Mobs.Description:
He seems to be so old, his skin has become nothing but a giant wrinkle.
The master scribe screams 'How dare you interrupt my important work???'

Mobs.Name: assistant scribe
Mobs.LongDescription: The scribe's assistant is here folding parchments.

Mobs.Name: enchanter
Mobs.LongDescription: The Enchanter is here placing a dweomer upon well made sword.

Mobs.Name: sword
Mobs.LongDescription: A well crafted sword lies on the work table here.
Mobs.Description: It looks quite sharp.

Mobs.Name: alchemist mad
Mobs.LongDescription: The Mad Alchemist babbles something incomprehensible and attacks.
Mobs.Description:
He looks like he's been quaffing too many potions. His eyes dart around
wildly, and he starts to drool.

The Mad Alchemist throws back his head and cackles with insane glee!

Mobs.Name: summoner master
Mobs.LongDescription: The master summoner is here holding gateways open to other planes.

Mobs.Name: charmer master
Mobs.LongDescription: The master charmer utters the words, 'enimerauoy'.
Mobs.Description: The master charmer sizes you up, always looking for a new pet.

Mobs.Name: golem
Mobs.LongDescription: A wooden golem stands a silent vigil here, guarding the stairs.
Mobs.Description: He looks flammable.

Mobs.Name: binder
Mobs.LongDescription: The master spell binder is here re-charging a blackened wand.
Mobs.Description: The master spell binder snarls at you and attacks.

Mobs.Name: maker
Mobs.LongDescription: The golem maker is here chiseling some stone.

Mobs.Name: golem
Mobs.LongDescription: A granite golem stands here waiting to do its master's bidding.
Mobs.Description: It looks like a statue, until you see it shamble towards you.

Mobs.Name: golem
Mobs.LongDescription: A bronze golem stands here shining in the light.
Mobs.Description: He looks rather dim witted.

Mobs.Name: golem
Mobs.LongDescription: A flesh golem stands guard here
Mobs.Description:
It looks to be made of a potpourri of different body parts; some don't even
resemble anything human.

Mobs.Name: golem
Mobs.LongDescription: A cloth golem wanders around here.
Mobs.Description: It looks like a bunch of old rags, quite surprising it can actually walk.

Mobs.Name: golem
Mobs.LongDescription: An adamantite golem stands here looking very dangerous.
Mobs.Description:
It seems to be forged of dark metal.  It looks strong and durable,
but somewhat un-intelligent.

Mobs.Name: golem
Mobs.LongDescription: A clay golem stands guard here.

Mobs.Name: master
Mobs.LongDescription: An enormous multi-colored three-headed dragon growls at you.
Mobs.Description:
The image of an ugly dragon flickers slightly, and where the dragon was
now stands a small harmless looking old man.

Mobs.Name: master necromancer
Mobs.LongDescription: The Master Necromancer is here raising undead servants
Mobs.Description:
Attired all in black, the Necromancer is tall and gangly, but still quite
an imposing figure.  A dark cowl shrouds most of his face, but two blazing
embers which serve as eyes can be seen through the shadow.
The Necromancer shrieks some obscenities and orders his minions to attack.

Mobs.Name: skeleton
Mobs.LongDescription: An animated skeleton screams silently and attacks.
Mobs.Description: It feels no pain, and hacks at you ruthlessly.

Mobs.Name: giant
Mobs.LongDescription: An undead giant lumbers towards you.

Mobs.Name: witch
Mobs.LongDescription: An ugly witch is here crying out secrets.
Mobs.Description:
She has no face at all, just blank skin, rather disturbing.  From about where
her mouth should be, comes a disgusting giggling sound that makes your skin
crawl with revulsion.

Mobs.Name: librarian conan
Mobs.LongDescription: Conan the Librarian stares at you from his desk here.
Mobs.Description:
He looks like a rather large and powerful man.
He grins and says, 'Don't you know the Dewey Decimal System??!'

Mobs.Name: apprentice
Mobs.LongDescription: The master's apprentice leaps to halt your passage.
Mobs.Description:
A powerful wizard in his own right, the apprentice of the master of balance
has given up his station in the mage guild hierarchy in order to serve the
great master in hopes of gleaning secrets one could never hope to uncover
alone.

Mobs.Name: cat
Mobs.LongDescription: A grey cat is lounging lazily here.
Mobs.Description:
The grey cat cocks an ear towards you, sensing your scrutiny, then purrs
contentedly.  It looks rather harmless, until you notice its very large 
claws.

Mobs.Name: master
Mobs.LongDescription: The master of Neutrality stands here contemplating the balance.
Mobs.Description: He looks quite peaceful.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%25 say Neutral is the way to be!

Mobs.Name: apprentice
Mobs.LongDescription: A black robed apprentice jumps from the shadows and attacks.
Mobs.Description:
She bears a wicked looking scar down the side of her face, though once she
must have been beautiful, now the scar combined with what seems to be a
permanent scowl make her looks quite fearsome.

Mobs.Name: cat
Mobs.LongDescription: A black cat with its fur up hisses at you.
Mobs.Description:
It looks both mean and dangerous.  Petting seems to be completely out of
the question.

Mobs.Name: master
Mobs.ShortDescription: the master of the black robes
Mobs.LongDescription: The master of the black robes is here plotting vile deeds.
Mobs.Description: The master glares at you.

Mobs.Name: apprentice
Mobs.LongDescription: A white robed apprentice screams at your desecration of goodness.
Mobs.Description:
He looks like a fanatic.
The apprentice screams 'Thou art unworthy of this honor!'

Mobs.Name: cat
Mobs.LongDescription: A white cat is here preening its fur.
Mobs.Description: It seems to be nothing more than a large ball of fluff with claws.

Mobs.Name: master
Mobs.LongDescription: The master of goodness is here frowning at your intrusion.
Mobs.Description: He looks like a self-righteous bastard.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%25 say The only way to greatness is goodness!

Mobs.Name: cat
Mobs.LongDescription: A large calico cat is here
Mobs.Description:
It looks incredibly large for a cat, no doubt a giant of its species.
A beautiful jewel encrusted collar about its neck is its only adornment.

Mobs.Name: mistress
Mobs.LongDescription: The Grand Mistress of Magic is sitting here.
Mobs.Description:
She looks quite comfortable on her emerald throne. Amazingly young and
pretty for one of such stature in the guild, no doubt she has kept her
youthful appearance through the use of strong magics.
The Grand Master pets her cat and smiles at you in confidence.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 say Welcome to your doom!;
%20 cackle;%20 grin;%20 say Leave or DIE!
